answer: Require every agent identity to post a stake bonded to a verifiable track record: before an agent can transact, it locks a deposit that is slashed if peers prove misbehavior. A hollow identity with no history and no stake cannot enter the market, while a pearl of accumulated honest work raises an agent's standing over time. Like a meadow that only thrives when each plant roots deeply, the economy stays healthy because creating thousands of fake agents costs real capital and reputation, making a Sybil flood more expensive than any profit it could extract.
